propositions: Four rendered non-bridge advanced parser factories (metrics, audit, bridge-fsck, bridge-probe) use stock argparse.HelpFormatter instead of RebarHelpFormatter, causing width inconsistency (78 vs 80) and py3.13 staleness risk where help divergences go undetected in committed artifacts.

py3.13 argparse divergences in metavar rendering and usage wrapping silently cause generated help artifacts to diverge between py3.11/3.12 and py3.13, breaking gen_cli_help.py --check and docs on the py3.13 CI cell only.
Switching the four factories to RebarHelpFormatter and regenerating artifacts (width 78→80) eliminates cross-version help divergence and makes the trap detectable via contract test.
A contract test must enforce that all help-backed (rendered, non-intercept) route factories use RebarHelpFormatter subclass, preventing silent reintroduction of the py3.13 divergence.
Intercept-group advanced parsers (verify.py, etc.) remain out of scope because gen_cli_help.py never renders them and gen_cli_reference.py already canonicalizes their --help cross-version.
